title: Swords in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
description: The Six to Ten of Swords in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for transition, strategy, feeling trapped, anxiety and endings, as prompts for reflection.

scenes.headline: Swords in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
scenes.caption: The Six to Ten of Swords carry the suit of thought through transition, secrecy, feeling trapped, worry and the end of a hard stretch.
scenes.vo: The Six to Ten of Swords carry the suit of thought through transition, secrecy, feeling trapped, worry and the end of a hard stretch.

scenes.headline: Six of Swords
scenes.caption: Transition, moving on, leaving rough waters. In RWS, a ferryman poles a boat carrying a covered figure and a child across water, with six swords standing upright in the boat.
scenes.vo: Six of Swords. Transition, moving on, leaving rough waters. In RWS, a ferryman poles a boat carrying a covered figure and a child across water, with six swords standing upright in the boat.

scenes.headline: Seven of Swords
scenes.caption: Strategy, stealth, acting alone. A figure tiptoes away from a camp carrying five swords and leaving two behind.
scenes.vo: Seven of Swords. Strategy, stealth, acting alone. A figure tiptoes away from a camp carrying five swords and leaving two behind.
